Maya (docs): Heads-up: opened PR #9827 to tidy the SDK auth example + add a short migration note. Need quick legal/security sign-off before we merge tonight. cc @Aisha @Liam
Docs CI: Preview failed for PR-9827: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-9827 — 1 secret hit detected.
Sam P: What secret?
Docs CI: Build log snippet:
```
Scanning file: docs/reference/sdk/auth.md
Line 39: possible private key pattern found: '-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----'
```
Maya (docs): Oof, that old snippet slipped in with a real-looking key. I must've copied it from a private note when updating examples.
Aisha (legal): We need to redact that immediately. Docs cannot contain real keys or customer ARNs. Please replace with placeholders and add an explicit admonition about not pasting credentials.
Liam (security): Also saw an AWS account number in the sample (123456789012). Must be replaced with <ACCOUNT_ID> or similar.
Evan (eng): I'll push a quick patch to switch to env vars and placeholders. Suggested change:
```
const redwood = new Redwood({
  apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY, // do not paste real credentials here
  kmsKey: '<REDACTED_KMS_KEY>'
});
```
Maya (docs): Can you also add a one-line migration tip about rotating keys when you rotate credentials in prod? Ops asked for that in the release PR.
Evan (eng): Yep will add a short line and link to internal KMS rotation doc.
Docs CI: Rerun triggered by @Evan — status: running...
Docs CI: Preview build successful — no secrets detected. https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-9827 ✅
Maya (docs): Thanks. @Aisha @Liam please mark approvals if wording looks fine. We want this live before the minor release cutoff at 18:00 PT.
Aisha (legal): Approved after redaction. Please reference legal ticket LEG-342 in the commit message. ✅
Liam (security): Approved after replacing account ID with <ACCOUNT_ID> and small wording tweak in security notes to avoid implying key sharing. 👍
Sam P: Good. I'll do the squash-and-merge if all approvals are present. Add `docs/final-review` label and I'll merge.
Maya (docs): Added label. Also updated release notes with a brief "SDK auth example clarified" line.
Docs CI: Merge queued — manual approval required from Sam P. Reminder: run `make docs-release` when publishing HTML assets post-merge.
Sam P: Merged PR-9827 (squash) and ran docs release process. :shipit:
Maya (docs): Thanks team. Filed follow-up ticket DOCS-225 to scan other SDK snippets for accidental credentials. Closing thread.
